songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus (English)
aliases: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
songs.body:
{comment: Verse 1}
[G]What a friend we have in [C]Jesus,
[G]All our sins and griefs to [D]bear!
[G]What a privilege to [C]carry
[G]Everything to [D]God in [G]prayer!
[D]O what peace we often [G]forfeit,
[C]O what needless pain we [D]bear,
[G]All because we do not [C]carry
[G]Everything to [D]God in [G]prayer!
{comment: Verse 2}
[G]Have we trials and temp[C]tations?
[G]Is there trouble any[D]where?
[G]We should never be dis[C]couraged;
[G]Take it to the [D]Lord in [G]prayer.
[D]Can we find a friend so [G]faithful,
[C]Who will all our sorrows [D]share?
[G]Jesus knows our every [C]weakness;
[G]Take it to the [D]Lord in [G]prayer.
{comment: Verse 3}
[G]Are we weak and heavy [C]laden,
[G]Cumbered with a load of [D]care?
[G]Precious Savior, still our [C]refuge,
[G]Take it to the [D]Lord in [G]prayer.
[D]Do thy friends despise, for[G]sake thee?
[C]Take it to the Lord in [D]prayer!
[G]In his arms he'll take and [C]shield thee;
[G]Thou wilt find a [D]solace [G]there.
songs.source: Joseph M. Scriven, Charles C. Converse · https://hymnary.org/hymn/LUYH2013/897
